value: Unified namespace over distributed storage
quote: iRODS implements data virtualization, allowing access to distributed storage assets under a unified namespace

value: Data stays where it is stored
quote: It virtualizes data storage resources, so users can take control of their data, regardless of where and on what device the data is stored.

value: MESA states one policy engine and data stays where it lives
quote: One policy engine across the CyVerse Data Store and its federated peers, with CILogon, Globus Auth, and ORCID handling identity. The lakehouse and the mesh interoperate — your data stays where it lives, and still shows up where you work.

value: PEPs run before and after every operation
quote: Within the REPF, there are dynamically created policy enforcement points that are checked before and after every operation.
notes: Basis for 'rules fire on ingest' (pep_api_data_obj_put_*) and for a pre-check on every request

value: A failing _pre PEP blocks the operation
quote: Note that if pep_PLUGINOPERATION_pre() fails, the PLUGINOPERATION will not be called.
notes: Mechanism to deny deletes before they touch data; a policy must be written, it is not default

value: Fail-early gives admin control over allowed operations
quote: This ability to fail early allows for fine-grained control of which plugin operations may or may not be allowed as defined by the policy of the data grid administrator.

value: Delete has its own pre-PEP
quote: pep_api_data_obj_unlink_prersComm_t * rsCommdataObjInp_t * dataObjUnlinkInp
source_title: Dynamic Policy Enforcement Points (API PEP table)
notes: Table cells run together after HTML stripping; rsComm carries the requesting user, dataObjInp the path

value: PEP context carries the requesting user and zone
quote: user_rods_zone=tempZone++++user_sys_uid=0++++user_user_name=rods
notes: 'Who is asking' and 'which zone' are available to the rule

value: Default delete goes to trash; -f bypasses
quote: By default, the data objects are moved to the trash collection (/myZone/trash) unless the -f option is used.
notes: 'No deleted datasets' is not default behaviour; it needs a policy

value: iRODS 4.3 has 10 permission levels
quote: The iRODS Permission Model is linear with 10 levels.
notes: own / modify_object / read_object are three of the ten

value: write/read are aliases
quote: To maintain backwards compatibility, 'write' and 'read' are provided as aliases to 'modify_object' and 'read_object' respectively.

value: Delete needs delete_object; read-only account cannot delete
quote: - irm - requires 'delete_object' or greater - imv - requires 'delete_object' or greater, due to removal of old name - iput - requires 'modify_object' or greater - iget - requires 'read_object' or greater
notes: An account with read_object only cannot delete, move or overwrite

value: Owner has full control and can share
quote: The owner of a Data Object has full control of the file and can grant and remove access to other users and groups.

value: Creator gets own by default
quote: By default, the original creator of a dataObject has 'own' permission.

value: Audit plugin emits a message per PEP
quote: The iRODS Audit Rule Engine Plugin provides the iRODS platform a C++ rule engine that emits a single AMQP message to the configured topic for every policy enforcement point (PEP) encountered by the iRODS server.
notes: Optional plugin that must be installed and configured; not on by default

value: Zones are independent administrative units
quote: iRODS zones are independent administrative units.

value: One iCAT per zone
quote: There is one iCAT database per iRODS Zone.
notes: Federated zones keep their own catalogs

value: Federation preserves local control
quote: Rather than a single iRODS zone managed by one administrator, they may need two (or more) cooperating iRODS systems managed locally, primarily for security and/or authorization reasons.

value: MESA's Formation connector acts as the signed-in user, with delete
quote: every tool then acts as that user.
notes: Tool list includes delete_data: this connector does not use a separate read-only agent account

value: Formation tools include delete_data
